tools.name: start-audit
tools.description: Starts an audit exactly as the REST start operation (configuration reference; optional limit overrides).

tools.name: pause-audit
tools.description: Checkpoints and pauses a running audit.

tools.name: resume-audit
tools.description: Rehydrates and resumes a paused audit.

tools.name: cancel-audit
tools.description: Drains workers and finalizes partial data.

tools.name: re-audit
tools.description: Triggers a follow-up analysis pass over the same dataset; returns the new audit identifier.

tools.name: analyze-single-page
tools.description: Ad-hoc single-page audit: findings and element inventory for one URL.

tools.name: run-schedule-now
tools.description: Manual trigger of a schedule; returns the started audit identifier.

tools.name: get-audit-progress
tools.description: Reads live progress for an audit (status, phase, counters).

resources.name: audit-summary
resources.description: Audit overview: status, scores, metric summaries, finding counts, WAF counts.

resources.name: high-severity-findings
resources.description: Error and Warning findings with evidence and recommendations.

resources.name: url-detail
resources.description: URL record with findings, WAF detection, scope diagnostics, top n-grams, SERP metrics, semantic relations.

resources.name: audit-list
resources.description: All audits with status and phase.

resources.name: schedule-status
resources.description: Schedule definitions with next-due and recent runs.

resources.name: crawl-progress
resources.description: Live progress with throttle summary and redirect-matrix counters.

resources.name: extracted-content
resources.description: Custom extraction values and stored body text for one URL.

resources.name: ngram-analysis
resources.description: N-gram site summaries and per-URL frequencies (zone/order filters).

resources.name: waf-blocks
resources.description: WAF detections with provider, challenge class, and evidence.

resources.name: log-correlation
resources.description: True orphans, budget waste, and uncrawled indexable URLs for a log import.

resources.name: semantic-link-opportunities
resources.description: Semantic link opportunities and cannibalization clusters (suggestions only).

resources.name: geo-readiness
resources.description: llms.txt validation results and AI-bot governance summary.

resources.name: analytics-coverage
resources.description: Per-container analytics coverage across indexable pages.

prompts.name: audit-health-briefing
prompts.description: Composes the audit summary into an agent-ready health briefing; no side effects.

prompts.name: high-severity-triage
prompts.description: Composes high-severity findings into a triage briefing; no side effects.

prompts.name: audit-delta-briefing
prompts.description: Composes a cross-audit comparison into a delta briefing; no side effects.

prompts.name: ngram-topical-briefing
prompts.description: Composes ngram-analysis + audit-summary into a topical briefing; no side effects.

prompts.name: semantic-topical-briefing
prompts.description: Composes semantic-link-opportunities + audit-summary into a topical briefing; no side effects.
